title: Prime Medicine, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Prime Medicine, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Svetlana Makhni as Chief Financial Officer, effective April 16, 2026. Makhni, age 42, joins from Marengo Therapeutics with over 20 years of experience in biotech CFO roles and investment banking. Her employment agreement includes a $495,000 annual base salary, $40,000 sign-on bonus, and 40% target annual bonus eligibility. The filing details standard executive compensation and severance provisions.
key_points: Svetlana Makhni appointed CFO and principal financial officer effective April 16, 2026
Base salary: $495,000 annually with $40,000 sign-on bonus
Target annual bonus: 40% of base salary
Pre-CFO experience includes CFO roles at Marengo Therapeutics (2022-2026) and Escient Pharmaceuticals (2021-2022)
Investment banking background at BMO Capital Markets, Goldman Sachs, and Blackstone (2006-2019)
Change-in-control severance: 12 months base salary plus 1.0x target bonus, plus 12 months health coverage
